prompt:
Write a CommonJS JavaScript module. Export exactly the requested function with module.exports = functionName. Use no imports, dependencies, filesystem or network. Return only one fenced javascript code block, with no explanation.

Implement globMatch(pattern, text), returning boolean. Match the entire text, case-sensitively. Unescaped * matches zero or more UTF-16 code units, ? matches exactly one. Backslash escapes the next pattern code unit; a trailing backslash means a literal backslash. All other characters, including regex punctuation, are literal. Newline is an ordinary code unit. No filesystem operations.
